parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, targeting, or violent incident is documented, and the same-sex offences were a never-enforced dead letter repealed in 2023 after a parliamentary process citing growing LGBT acceptance, with an LGBTI organisation able to submit. This structure extrapolates toward a tolerant, law-bound society rather than a hostile state. Against that, the dossier is thin and silent on every traveler-facing trans axis: passport/marker practice (passport rules supplied externally), facilities, hospital/custody placement, police practice, healthcare and any working anti-discrimination recourse, and it documents no specific acceptance of gender diversity or protective enforcement. Absence of evidence in this thin record is not safety, but there is also no known universal exposure or organised targeting. That places it a step below acceptance-with-working-protections, in the 0.65 range.
